description: Get the latest Swiss news headlines from SRF (Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen). Returns top news articles with title, description, link, and publication date.

category.description: News category. "switzerland" = domestic Swiss news (default), "international" = world news, "economy" = business & economy.

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default: 10, max: 50)

name: get_swiss_news
